text: liteq implements serverless message queue system R. can handle multiple databases, database can contain multiple queues. liteq uses SQLite store database queues, uses , temporary SQLites databases locking, finding crashed workers (see ).

title: Lightweight Portable Message Queue Using SQLite
text: following create queue temporary queue database. database removed R session quits. Note ensure_queue() idempotent, call database, return queue created previously. safe call multiple times, even multiple processes. case multiple processes, locking mechanism eliminates race conditions. publish message queue, call publish() queue object: liteq message title, string scalar, message body string scalar well. use complex data types messages, need serialize using serialize() function (set ascii TRUE!), convert JSON jsonlite package. Two functions available consume message queue. try_consume() returns immediately, either message (liteq_message object), NULL queue empty. consume() function blocks queue empty, waits message appears . title message body available fields message object: consumer done processing message must call ack() message object, notify queue safe remove message. consumer fails process message, can call nack() (negative ackowledgement) message object. status message set "FAILED". Failed messages can removed queue, put back queue , depending application. queue empty now, try_consume() returns NULL:
code: library(liteq) db <- tempfile() q <- ensure_queue("jobs", db = db) q #> liteq queue 'jobs' list_queues(db) #> [[1]] #> liteq queue 'jobs' publish(q, title = "First message", message = "Hello world!") publish(q, title = "Second message", message = "Hello again!") list_messages(q) #>   id          title status #> 1  1  First message  READY #> 2  2 Second message  READY msg <- try_consume(q) msg #> liteq message from queue 'jobs': #>   First message (12 B) msg$title #> [1] "First message" msg$message #> [1] "Hello world!" ack(msg) list_messages(q) #>   id          title status #> 1  2 Second message  READY msg2 <- try_consume(q) nack(msg2) list_messages(q) #>   id          title status #> 1  2 Second message FAILED try_consume(q) #> NULL

title: liteq 1.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-11-05 publish() now accepts multiple messages (note title message must length) publishes single transaction (#25, @Enchufa2). Setting R_LITEQ_BUSY_TIMEOUT environment variable now works properly. Previously ignored timeout set ten seconds (#24, @Enchufa2). liteq now works better many concurrent workers, fails much less often “database locked” errors (#28, #29, @Enchufa2): Checking crashed workers wait busy timeout message worked . Previously, kept database locked long time, busy timeout times number active workers. write transactions now use BEGIN IMMEDIATE. avoids deadlocks writers, readers (e.g. list_messages()) blocked another process writing. write operations, including ensure_queue() publish(), now keep waiting database lock, like consume() ack() already . Previously failed get lock within busy timeout.

title: liteq 1.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2019-03-08 Work around SQLITE bug resets database busy timeout successful query. Now set timeout database operation. timeout can now also set via R_LITEQ_BUSY_TIMEOUT environment variable, defaults 10 seconds, instead 1 second. consume() now poll_interval argument set often poll queue new jobs. New is_empty() message_count() functions (#18, @wlandau). Get rid annoying warning closing unused connections (#15, #20, @wlandau).
